title: Text API gets more room to run
summary:
The text API got a higher configured request limit and better tracking, while contribution tooling and architecture docs caught up with reality.

The text API’s configured limit increased from 20 to 40 requests per minute, with localhost and pollinations.github.io added as allowed domains. The same PR fixed tracking for successful generations and errors.

MentatBot replaced the OpenHands GitHub resolver. Its workflow now responds to `mentat`-labeled issues and pull requests instead of comment and review triggers. The README and homepage references were updated, then the homepage wording was shortened to “AI assistant.”

The README diagram now shows Mistral, Qwen, and Llama through Scaleway and Deepseek through its API, rather than placing Mistral and Llama under Azure.
